summary: Population-weighted aggregation of a climate variable to org units (CHAP CSV)

parameters.name: dataset_id
parameters.description: Published climate GeoZarr collection to aggregate (e.g. cicero_pm25_daily).

parameters.name: population_dataset_id
parameters.description: Published population GeoZarr collection used as weights.

parameters.name: temporal_extent
parameters.description: Time range to load the climate data as [start, end] ISO-8601 dates.

parameters.name: geometries
parameters.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of organisation units. Each feature's id becomes the CSV location.

parameters.name: period_type
parameters.description: Period type used to format each time step as time_period (day, week, month, quarter, year). Should match the climate dataset's native resolution.
